feat: add observability, logging, and trace/log correlation stack
body:
Roll out structured logging (Winston + CloudWatch + S3 daily archive),
OpenTelemetry tracing/metrics via a self-hosted collector exporting to
AWS X-Ray and CloudWatch, Sentry cron monitoring, and end-to-end
correlationId/traceparent propagation across HTTP, SQS, and EventBridge
workers so logs, traces, and queue messages all line up.

- Adds RequestContextStorage (AsyncLocalStorage) plus a shared
  WorkerObservabilityService that wraps SQS/cron handlers in OTEL spans
  and Sentry check-ins, stamps logs with correlationId/requestId/traceId,
  and creates a fresh local requestId per consumer attempt.
- Publishes correlationId and W3C traceparent/baggage as SQS message
  attributes from every producer (shared SqsService and direct
  @ssut/nestjs-sqs handlers via a new sendWithSqsObservability helper),
  and extracts them on the consumer side so producer/consumer logs
  share a trace.
- Instruments contract, insurance, signing reminder, export, RFP mail,
  and notification listeners; aggregates partial failures in
  contract/insurance expiry crons so observeCronJob reports failure to
  Sentry instead of silently swallowing sub-step errors.
- Sanitizes shared SQS publisher debug logs to drop full message bodies
  and replaces verbose raw-body logging in the RFP mail listener with
  structured events.
- Adds the logger-infra scaffold (OTEL collector config, docker-compose,
  install script, env example), wires CI/workflow env vars, and ships
  observability docs (README, runbooks, setup checklist, metrics/alerts,
  EventBridge cron monitoring) plus the design spec and plan for trace/
  log correlation.

subject: feat(authentication): add cross-tab session sync for login and logout
body:
When a user has the app open in multiple browser tabs, logging out in
one tab left the others on authenticated pages until a manual reload
or an API call detected the expired session. Similarly, logging in on
one tab did not update other tabs sitting on the login page.

Introduce a BroadcastChannel-based sync mechanism that notifies all
same-origin tabs in real time when the auth state changes:

- LOGOUT: receiving tabs delegate to the existing logoutSession flow
  (clear storage, reset Redux/React Query, navigate to /login). The
  Amplify signOut call uses local-only mode on receiving tabs since
  the initiating tab already revoked tokens globally. A re-broadcast
  guard (isBroadcastLogout) prevents echo loops between tabs.

- LOGIN: receiving tabs verify they are not already authenticated and
  that a valid token exists in shared storage before reloading, which
  lets useInitAuthSession bootstrap the session naturally.

- Axios 401 interceptor: forced logouts triggered by token refresh
  failure now also broadcast, so sibling tabs are notified when any
  tab's API call causes a session termination.

Files changed:
- New: useAuthBroadcast.ts (channel, broadcasters, listener hook)
- Modified: useAuth.ts (broadcast on logout, inner try/catch for signOut)
- Modified: AuthRedirectHandler.tsx (mount listener, broadcast on MS SSO)
- Modified: LoginForm.tsx (broadcast on email/password login)
- Modified: config.ts (broadcast on 401-forced logout)
- Modified: hooks/index.ts (re-export new module)

  CodeExtension, CodeBlockExtension. Without these, ProseMirror strips those
  elements on parse and they are lost on save.
- In remirrorHtml.style.css, override Tailwind Preflight so semantic elements
  render correctly: per-level heading sizes (h1–h6), list-style for ul/ol and
  nested ol (lower-alpha/lower-roman), table header (th) bold + background,
  caption, strikethrough, mark/highlight, inline code and pre/code blocks, links,
